findings.original: He says: "We have evolved with the capacity to be dishonest. It's part of our evolutionary psychological make up – because if we gain an advantage over the people around us, we have a greater chance of surviving."
findings.rewritten: Dishonest people get more than others. So they live longer.
findings.why: 原文表达的是进化心理学观点：获得优势增加了生存几率（greater chance of surviving），这是一种概率和机制的描述。A1- 版本将其改写为“Dishost people get more than others. So they live longer.”，这变成了对个体事实的断言（不诚实的人确实活得更长），改变了原文的确定性程度和逻辑关系（从“增加生存几率”变为“导致寿命延长”），属于事实层面的扭曲。
